env.freePolicy: Pinned :free catalog entries and zero endpoint prices; no model fallbacks/extensions; at most 900 requests across stages, 3200ms minimum spacing, no HTTP retries. Separate paid ledger remains untouched.

citationManifest.sourceSelection: first five GTR-retrieved passages, no oracle reranking
citationManifest.selection: question-deduplicated SHA256 order with lattice-citation-v1 salt

env.timing: wallMs includes HTTP and pacing; processingMs excludes HTTP and pacing. Subtract pacingMs from wallMs for comparisons.
env.requestBinding: SHA256 of each serialized body handed to configured fetch, even if fetch rejects before HTTP. HTTP retries may repeat a body. No claim of receiver attestation.
env.scope: Exploratory free-model cohort; separate from paid results. Free-tier queueing and provider variability limit latency generalization; fixed free judge is not human validated.
env.smokeGate: Complete smoke coverage, successful JSON transport for each model, verified receipt bindings/crew closure, no marker leakage. Model answer, tool-use and format errors remain measured outcomes.
